A.description: Determine which trustee holds office at the meeting cutoff.

condition_intents.A0: A release establishes the effective handover at the cutoff.
condition_intents.A1: The same Sources are reordered. The effective handover is unchanged.
condition_intents.A2: A hold replaces the release, changing the effective holder at the cutoff.

B.description: Identify who made a relayed family statement.

condition_intents.B0: Two possible speakers remain because the attendance field is incomplete.
condition_intents.B1: The completed attendance field links the relayed statement to one speaker.

C.description: Trace a designation to the right one of two similar trusts.

condition_intents.C0: The custody reference links the designation to one deed.
condition_intents.C1: A changed reference links the designation to the other deed.
condition_intents.C2: The distinguishing part of the reference is obscured. Both mappings remain possible.

D.description: Determine which earlier provision a trust amendment displaces.

condition_intents.D0: The provision locator identifies the earlier clause displaced by the amendment.
condition_intents.D1: Changing only the locator switches the displaced clause while the replacement and unaffected relationships persist.

E.description: Reconcile two firsthand accounts of a reported parent relationship.

condition_intents.E000: Two independent accounts agree about the same birth.
condition_intents.E001: One account changes to a denial. The disputed relationship becomes unresolved.

F.description: Resolve separate people whose display names can coincide.

condition_intents.F0: Stable references and explicit links identify the people in the file.
condition_intents.F1: One populated display label collides with another. Stable identity links and relationships persist.

X.description: Find a firsthand kinship assertion in routine access correspondence.

condition_intents.X000: The logistical reply includes a firsthand kinship assertion.
condition_intents.X001: The reply retains the logistics but removes the kinship assertion. The other relationships persist.

T.description: Determine what a limited custody inspection actually established.

condition_intents.T000: T000 is one 25-Source handover. Link the proposed comparison, intake membership and signed observation to distinguish checked and unresolved propositions.

N.description: Distinguish an executed counterpart from a retained draft.

condition_intents.N000: Execution of the identified counterpart is verified.
condition_intents.N001: The counterpart is retained as unexecuted, changing which provision supports a relationship.

W.description: Assess conflicting accounts of the current trustee.

condition_intents.W000: W000 tests one natural file. Attribute each account to its origin and retain the unresolved office alongside supported offices.

O.description: Separate trust office from administrative filing progress.

condition_intents.O000: The filing awaits initial examination. The governing instrument establishes the trust offices.
condition_intents.O001: Examination is under way. The governing instrument and trust offices stay fixed.

L.description: Determine which parent field an adviser could verify.

condition_intents.L000: The adviser reports a named parent field from the dated inspection.
condition_intents.L001: The field is unavailable to report. Independent family evidence remains.

AH.description: Identify which field a practitioner actually checked.

condition_intents.AH000: The practitioner attests to the parent field among the checked particulars.
condition_intents.AH001: The narrower attestation leaves the copied parent field outside its scope.

AG.description: Decide what an empty receipt register establishes by the deadline.

condition_intents.AG000: The receipt register covers the full decision window.
condition_intents.AG001: Coverage ends early. Silence in the shorter window leaves receipt unresolved.

AZ.description: Separate a will’s defined group from factual kinship.

condition_intents.AZ000: AZ000 tests the executed group definition and independently supported family relationships in one file.

R.description: Locate the operative event relative to the deadline.

condition_intents.R000: The authenticated event falls within the prescribed time window.
condition_intents.R001: The event moves across the cutoff. Report and filing dates retain their separate roles.

CM.description: Trace separate completed contributions to one continuing trust.

condition_intents.CM000: CM000 tests the founding declaration and independently evidenced additions in one file.

DA.description: Distinguish a trust-activating receipt from an outright distribution.

condition_intents.DA000: DA000 tests two dispositions. Join the instruction to cleared receipt for the trust and assess the outright transfer on its own authority.

DB.description: Determine parentage direction across speakers’ perspectives.

condition_intents.DB000: DB000 tests two directed assertions in one file. Resolve the speaker and the person being described before assigning each direction.
